dialogues.speaker: Port Ormos Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This Bulletin Board is set up by the Port Master of Port Ormos to publicize important matters in and around Port Ormos. Questions or doubts regarding the notices on the Bulletin Board can be posted here as well.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Struggling with paper format? Still trying to find ideas for your paper? It's time to try something new!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I majored in Hara{RUBY#[S]Semiotics}vatat and am proficient in both Span{RUBY#[S]Elementalism}tamad and Kshah{RUBY#[S]Technology}rewar. Providing Q&A services on paper writing."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Time to wriggle out of your pains. Contact Mr. Amandeep at the hotel. Service fee negotiable."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Do you ghostwrite?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "No, the Inspector will not allow such behavior."

dialogues.speaker: Message by the Inspector
dialogues.text: "Indeed. Focus on your study and do not try your luck."

dialogues.speaker: Fontaine Flyers Advertisement
dialogues.text: Have you heard of levitation? Have you seen someone flying? Would you like to discover the secrets of the flying Sumpter Beast? Then don't miss out on the Fontaine Flyers' first performance in Sumeru!

dialogues.speaker: Fontaine Flyers Advertisement
dialogues.text: Welcome, show's on! Don't miss this unique performance of art! Only five Mora for a ticket.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "It was wonderful. I've never seen anything like it, even in Fontaine!"

dialogues.speaker: The Eremites Announcement
dialogues.text: Special reminder: The Eremites are the only authorized mercenary organization in Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: The Eremites Announcement
dialogues.text: Please do not trust strangers easily in case of getting cheated by scammers.

dialogues.speaker: The Eremites Announcement
dialogues.text: If you wish to hire bodyguards, security staff, or have any other requests, please contact Captain Feroz of the Corps of Thirty at Port Ormos.

dialogues.speaker: Port Master Notice
dialogues.text: Personal info and reasons for all docking ships need to be reported to the Port Master.

dialogues.speaker: Port Master Notice
dialogues.text: Merchant ships need to provide details on the cargo.

dialogues.speaker: Port Master Notice
dialogues.text: Merchant ships shall not unload cargo or trade without registration here. Any violation will face severe punishment.

dialogues.speaker: Port Master Notice
dialogues.text: Investigations are being conducted to track smuggling. All goods passing through the port need to be registered and inspected.

dialogues.speaker: Port Master Notice
dialogues.text: All unregistered or contraband goods will be confiscated.

dialogues.speaker: Port Master Notice
dialogues.text: All consequences shall be borne by the cargo owner.

dialogues.speaker: Lighthouse Guardian Notice
dialogues.text: Watch out for sea beasts!

dialogues.speaker: Lighthouse Guardian Notice
dialogues.text: We have witnessed an increased sea beasts activity recently. Ships leaving the port should pay attention to warnings issued by Pharos Lighthouse, or obtain maritime information in advance through Akasha.

dialogues.speaker: Lighthouse Guardian Notice
dialogues.text: For any questions, please contact the Lighthouse Guardian.

dialogues.speaker: Shapur Hotel Advertisement
dialogues.text: As the largest hotel in Port Ormos, we provide the most thoughtful services for merchants and tourists.

dialogues.speaker: Shapur Hotel Advertisement
dialogues.text: We have a special discount for students and graduates of the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Shapur Hotel Advertisement
dialogues.text: If you need to store goods, please contact Wikala Funduq.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The service at Shapur Hotel is good, but their sound insulation is awful."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I stayed here because prices in Port Ormos were low. Now I'll have to move to Sumeru City."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If I failed the exam again this year, I'm gonna have to return home and be a farmer. Don't know if I can take some 'Anahitian Blessing' with me then..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "These Mahamata they sent are each more useless than the last. They can't answer a single question that I ask."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "And now that we have access to the Akasha, these amateur Mahamata are not even at my level."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "That Scribe we don't see very often who helped us sort out the shipping schedule last time is the only exception. Seems the Akademiya are not all dim-wits."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The burden on me gets heavier since Cyno became a General Mahamatra, but it's actually more relieving since I don't have to deal with the tedious factionalism anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Or I couldn't be loitering around here while on a research trip."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Don't know where Cyno has been. Guess I wouldn't get caught by him if I write it here."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I've seen it all. Report to me before tomorrow noon and receive punishment."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Don't waste my time."

dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Commerce Guild Advertisement
dialogues.text: Our commerce engages in the trade of gem products and precious ores produced in Liyue with sufficient stable supply channels and long-term cooperation with many fleets.

dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Commerce Guild Advertisement
dialogues.text: A handful of stylish silks are for sale. Limited offer!

dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Commerce Guild Advertisement
dialogues.text: Contact us if you have a good supply channel for Sumeru local blankets, herbs, gemstones, and brocade products. Let's trade and make friends!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Last month, I sailed to a country whose king had never seen a horse. Can you believe it?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "So I decided to sell some Sumpter Beasts there and tell them that those were horses, haha. If I closed a deal with them, perhaps I could be a king or something there!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "What is a king?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Like the Navbed or a Vizier, but with greater power than any of them. Pretty much the same as the legendary Twenty-Nine Deys. Gosh, it's so hard to describe."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "You're just making this up."

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Poem
dialogues.text: "So dully is the sage's preach. Bring the wine made from flowers, for there are the seven seas to reach."

dialogues.speaker: Sheriff Announcement
dialogues.text: To sailors, travelers, merchants, and port residents: The port regulations are announced here.

dialogues.speaker: Sheriff Announcement
dialogues.text: In case of dispute, contact Sheriff Shyam for assistance.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Instead of visiting the Grand Bazaar in Sumeru City, you should visit the old markets in Port Ormos."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The Grand Bazaar is messed up by the Mahamata. We are maintaining a lot more Sumeru traditions and characters here instead."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But, of course, if you want to watch a dancing performance, you still have to go to Zubayr Theater, though."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Peasants. The Sumeru City was built with a delicate plan by researchers. The zoning and planning of each and every area here are backed up by scientific research."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I see someone here is full of nonsense. The unruly streets in Port Ormos somehow have become treasures in their eyes!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "What's that? Can't hear you!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "This is embarrassing to say. We were workers that maintain merchant ships here, living off the maintenance skills passed down from generation to generation."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But some time ago, new technologies have been added to the Akasha, and our years of experience have become worthless. Young people can still learn through the Akasha, but old stuff like us have no choice but to change jobs."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The Scribe said we can go to sea and try our luck, but we have no money for something like that right now. If you have any gigs, please come to us."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Don't listen to the Scribe. I happen to know a big client who needs craftsmen. I'll introduce you to her. Take the money too. Forget about going to sea."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "I wish you could do less meaningless things. Some people will succeed and some will fall, that's how the world works. Why interfere with it just to act like a goody-two-shoes?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Here the Scribe goes again with the mysticism. Why did I do this, you say? Because it makes me happy!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "And don't you forget that mutual assistance, fairness, and righteous anger are also what drive the world, not the nonsense like 'the fittest survives'!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Make no mistake. I have never denied what you meant, but you don't understand what I am saying to you at all. End of conversation."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "It's a headache to argue with the impulsive. Anyway, where's your own budget? Don't tell me you're spending all your Akademiya subsidies on such nonsense."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "'The poor suffer from the rich's wealth. Thus the rich should give away their wealth for a good purpose.' says the sage Zolfikar."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "He never said that."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "He did."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "No, he never said that. And you'll pay for your drinks this month."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I won't argue with you about this. But give me a month. I'll prove that he said it."

dialogues.speaker: Trading Company Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Our company has opened the route to Dornman Port. We sincerely invite you to join our fruit business."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Wait a minute. Is it even possible to import fruit from Mondstadt, given the long voyage? I might be interested if you were talking about liquor."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Everyone knows importing wine from Mondstadt is a business, but importing fruit? Only I do such business here. That's why this is such a great business opportunity!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "And you don't actually need to import from Mondstadt..."

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Advertisement
dialogues.text: "The route to Ritou has been reopened. We sincerely invite you to join our business."

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Our Association's trade of wild mushrooms between Sumeru and Inazuma has been approved by the Port Master. We are now open to mushroom merchants for cooperation."

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Advertisement
dialogues.text: "You can also contact us if you encounter any problems or difficulties during your travel to Inazuma."

dialogues.speaker: Lighthouse Guardian Notice
dialogues.text: Watch out for sea beasts!

dialogues.speaker: Lighthouse Guardian Notice
dialogues.text: We have recently witnessed an increase in sea beast activity. Ships leaving the port should pay attention to warnings issued by Pharos Lighthouse, or obtain maritime information in advance through the Mahamata.

dialogues.speaker: Lighthouse Guardian Notice
dialogues.text: For any questions, please contact the Lighthouse Guardian.
